mods.title: FNF: Animania! V-Slice Port
mods.description: Friday Night Funkin': Animania! V-Slice Port Is HereAll Credits to Animania!Crew (already written in the credits section of the port)This is a port that replicates the FNF: Animania! mod 100% (or nearly so). I am not posting this to make a profit or to claim credit for myself; all credits are already listed.What's insideSongs and weeks: Week 1 (Bopeebo, Fresh, Dad Battle), Week 5 (Cocoa, Eggnog, Winter Horrorland) and the Komi "Phone Call" level, each with its own stages, characters and note styles.Recreated menus: title screen with its intro, main menu (with the OST button that opens Animania Crew's music links), Freeplay, Story Menu, loading screen with an audio visualizer, and pause menu. All were visually recreated and then manually coded. The rest of the menus are still being worked on.Pause menu with built-in options: change your keybinds, miss/hit sound volume, framerate, judgements, note splashes, camera shake, hints, flashing lights, auto pause and vsync without leaving the song.Winter Horrorland mechanic: fully working, with its own dodge/attack system, cinematic camera and a special game over.Animania HUD: curved health bar, time bar, score, rating/combo popups, Full Combo animation and custom icons with death animations.Story Mode continuity: your health and camera position carry over between songs of the same week, so transitions feel seamless.Solo Time: the special notes and splash included.Discord Rich Presence (PC) showing the menu or the song you're playing.Mobile and performance(Mobile only) A location selector for the Winter Horrorland mechanic button: left, center or right. You can find it in Options > Preferences.Performance options in Options > Preferences: turn off the custom shaders or enable "low quality" mode if your phone or tablet isn't very powerful.Compatible with the "Mobile Like PC" mod, so many of its options and settings will work (though you should avoid using "middlescroll" during songs that move the notes, unless that doesn't bother you).If you encounter any errors, you can reach out to me on TikTok or report the bug or issue here.The news menu is coming soon...

mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! mods.title: FNF: Día De Muertos Mix
mods.description: Thanks for clicking on our page.This is a V-Slice mod for Friday Night Funkin' based on the Mexican holiday "Día de los Muertos," also known as "Day of the Dead." Instead of your run-of-the-mill Halloween mod, why not one based on the holiday Halloween took from?This is Version 0.9 featuring 3 tracks at this time, including remixes of Spookeez and South, along with an original song featuring a brand new character named "Unir a Todos." He is a skeleton driven by the will of the fiesta, wanting to host the biggest party there ever was. Even if it means capturing attendees from across space and time. But it's totally all in good will, as he hopes to help people remember and move on from the deaths of loved ones.The soundtrack here is heavily inspired by Regional Mexican music, perhaps making it the first of its kind in terms of FNF mods. Preserving the sound was a major priority, as to make sure to not veer off into something more typical for FNF OST's.I, TheOnlyVolume, had a lot of fun figuring out the inner workings of how the genre works and how to execute it. I will be 100% transparent that I am approximately 0% Latin. But I wanted to do this project with absolutely NO INTENTION of exploiting the culture, but because I genuinely appreciate what it stands for and I genuinely had fun doing it. Even then, I made sure to have some Latin representation on the dev team. Not just for their talents, but also for their approval.Thank you to the multiple Latin friends I have who I showed this to for helping me make sure I wasn't doing anything wrong. Thank you, Sammy Andaluz, for being the reason this project was even conceived. And last, but not least, thank YOU for playing the mod.My biggest hope from this project is that actual Latin composers out there are not afraid to do this genre for FNF music. The diversity in how many genres there can be for FNF music is beautiful, and I'd personally love to see more mod OST's featuring this kind of sound.This mod will be updated to Version 1.0 at a later time, featuring more remixes of other FNF songs you may know, alongside more Unir content. But even then, that won't be it.Stay tuned!
